method.signal: swing_signals.swing_scores at a session close, then swing_signals.book_rows (entry percentile, eligibility floor and sector concentration cap applied exactly as the live screen applies them)
method.execution: next benchmark session close after the signal
method.weighting: equal weight (the composite is a signed z-score, so score-proportional weighting is not defined for it)
method.prices: pipeline/data/backtest_cache adjusted closes; benchmark from committed public/data/etf/SPY.json

bias_disclosures.reason: the backtest cache is today's universe walked backward, not dated index membership

bias_disclosures.market_cap_gate: disabled; no point-in-time share-count series exists in the cache
